title: Can’t get in the Mall and car trapped in garage
content: I have been having mallworld dreams several times a week for as long as I can remember. At least 10+ years. Last night was the first time I had a dream where I could not get in. Multiple levels that were familiar and some that were new but could not get past the outer entrances. Also my car got trapped in the parking garage and I had to pay $220 to get it released from a secret area. Very strange and very frustrating night!!
